description: AI verdict agent for the Reactive Circuit-Breaker (DoraHacks Reactive Omni Buildathon). Polls BurstFlagged on Reactive Lasna, classifies the burst with Groq (OpenAI-compatible) or a transparent heuristic fallback, and posts the verdict on-chain to VerdictOracle on Base Sepolia.
name: reactive-circuit-breaker-agent
